description: Media in the workspace, newest first. Put ready IDs in a post's media_ids. Add media with media_import_url (a link) or media_upload_url (a file you can PUT), or ask someone outside the team for theirs with file_request_create; request_id lists only what came in through one request.

before.description: next_before from the previous page, for older media

color.description: A hex color (#d9a441): only photos where it covers a meaningful share, the nearest match first (ignores before; up to limit)

color_delta.description: With color: how far a color may be from yours (0.15 is a close shade)

color_min_share.description: With color: the least share of the picture the color must cover

limit.description: How many files, newest first, e.g. 24

media_ids.description: With color: rank only these photos (for example the ones stills_pick_photos kept); no cut to the newest ones, and all that match are returned up to limit

request_id.description: Only files uploaded through this file request (a UUID): from file_requests_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_list
title: List media
